heroSubheading: Stock, service, parts and advice for all your outdoor power equipment
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Greytown, your local dealer for quality outdoor power equipment. We stock a full range of STIHL chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, and lawn equipment, and we're here to help locals find exactly what they need, keep their gear running, and get straight advice that actually helps.

James and the team know Greytown and what works for folks out here. Whether you're after new equipment, advice on what suits your block and your budget, spare parts to keep things going, or genuine repair and service, we can help. We sell honest gear and give honest advice—nothing more than you need.

Pop in and say hello. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday 8am to 2pm.
